target_database_schema:
-- Target Schema: Sales Analytics Star Schema
-- Dimension: Date
CREATE TABLE dim_date (
    date_key          integer      NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    full_date         date         NOT NULL,
    day_of_week       integer      NOT NULL,
    day_name          varchar(9)   NOT NULL,
    week_of_year      integer      NOT NULL,
    month_number      integer      NOT NULL,
    month_name        varchar(9)   NOT NULL,
    quarter           integer      NOT NULL,
    year              integer      NOT NULL,
    is_weekend        boolean      NOT NULL
);

-- Dimension: Customer
CREATE TABLE dim_customer (
    customer_key      integer      NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    customer_name     varchar(25)  NOT NULL,
    address           varchar(40),
    phone             char(15),
    account_balance   numeric,
    market_segment    char(10),
    nation_key        integer      NOT NULL,
    nation_name       char(25)     NOT NULL,
    region_key        integer      NOT NULL,
    region_name       char(25)     NOT NULL
);

-- Dimension: Supplier
CREATE TABLE dim_supplier (
    supplier_key      integer      NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    supplier_name     char(25)     NOT NULL,
    address           varchar(40),
    phone             char(15),
    account_balance   numeric,
    nation_key        integer      NOT NULL,
    nation_name       char(25)     NOT NULL,
    region_key        integer      NOT NULL,
    region_name       char(25)     NOT NULL
);

-- Dimension: Part
CREATE TABLE dim_part (
    part_key          integer      NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    part_name         varchar(55)  NOT NULL,
    manufacturer      char(25),
    brand             char(10),
    type              varchar(25),
    size              integer,
    container         char(10),
    retail_price      numeric
);

-- Fact: Sales
CREATE TABLE fact_sales (
    order_key         integer      NOT NULL,
    line_number       integer      NOT NULL,
    order_date_key    integer      NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),
    ship_date_key     integer      NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),
    commit_date_key   integer      REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),
    receipt_date_key  integer      REFERENCES dim_date(date_key),
    customer_key      integer      NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_customer(customer_key),
    supplier_key      integer      NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_supplier(supplier_key),
    part_key          integer      NOT NULL REFERENCES dim_part(part_key),
    quantity          numeric      NOT NULL,
    extended_price    numeric      NOT NULL,
    discount          numeric      NOT NULL,
    tax               numeric      NOT NULL,
    return_flag       char(1),
    line_status       char(1),
    ship_instructions char(25),
    ship_mode         char(10),
    supply_cost       numeric      NOT NULL,
    revenue           numeric      GENERATED ALWAYS AS (extended_price * (1 - discount)) STORED,
    profit            numeric      GENERATED ALWAYS AS (extended_price * (1 - discount) - supply_cost * quantity) STORED,
    PRIMARY KEY (order_key, line_number)
);

table_generation_queries.query:
WITH all_dates AS (
    SELECT o_orderdate AS dt FROM public.orders WHERE o_orderdate IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT l_shipdate FROM public.lineitem WHERE l_shipdate IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT l_commitdate FROM public.lineitem WHERE l_commitdate IS NOT NULL
    UNION
    SELECT l_receiptdate FROM public.lineitem WHERE l_receiptdate IS NOT NULL
),
unique_dates AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT dt FROM all_dates
)
SELECT 
    to_char(dt, 'YYYYMMDD')::integer AS date_key,
    dt AS full_date,
    EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM dt)::integer AS day_of_week,
    to_char(dt, 'Day') AS day_name,
    EXTRACT(WEEK FROM dt)::integer AS week_of_year,
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM dt)::integer AS month_number,
    to_char(dt, 'Month') AS month_name,
    EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM dt)::integer AS quarter,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt)::integer AS year,
    (EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM dt) IN (6,7)) AS is_weekend
FROM unique_dates
ORDER BY dt;

SELECT 
    c.c_custkey AS customer_key,
    c.c_name AS customer_name,
    c.c_address AS address,
    c.c_phone AS phone,
    c.c_acctbal AS account_balance,
    c.c_mktsegment AS market_segment,
    n.n_nationkey AS nation_key,
    n.n_name AS nation_name,
    r.r_regionkey AS region_key,
    r.r_name AS region_name
FROM public.customer c
JOIN public.nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN public.region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey;

SELECT 
    s.s_suppkey AS supplier_key,
    s.s_name AS supplier_name,
    s.s_address AS address,
    s.s_phone AS phone,
    s.s_acctbal AS account_balance,
    n.n_nationkey AS nation_key,
    n.n_name AS nation_name,
    r.r_regionkey AS region_key,
    r.r_name AS region_name
FROM public.supplier s
JOIN public.nation n ON s.s_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
JOIN public.region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey;

SELECT 
    p_partkey AS part_key,
    p_name AS part_name,
    p_mfgr AS manufacturer,
    p_brand AS brand,
    p_type AS type,
    p_size AS size,
    p_container AS container,
    p_retailprice AS retail_price
FROM public.part;

SELECT 
    l.l_orderkey AS order_key,
    l.l_linenumber AS line_number,
    to_char(o.o_orderdate, 'YYYYMMDD')::integer AS order_date_key,
    to_char(l.l_shipdate, 'YYYYMMDD')::integer AS ship_date_key,
    to_char(l.l_commitdate, 'YYYYMMDD')::integer AS commit_date_key,
    to_char(l.l_receiptdate, 'YYYYMMDD')::integer AS receipt_date_key,
    o.o_custkey AS customer_key,
    l.l_suppkey AS supplier_key,
    l.l_partkey AS part_key,
    l.l_quantity AS quantity,
    l.l_extendedprice AS extended_price,
    l.l_discount AS discount,
    l.l_tax AS tax,
    l.l_returnflag AS return_flag,
    l.l_linestatus AS line_status,
    l.l_shipinstruct AS ship_instructions,
    l.l_shipmode AS ship_mode,
    ps.ps_supplycost AS supply_cost
FROM public.lineitem l
JOIN public.orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN public.partsupp ps ON l.l_partkey = ps.ps_partkey AND l.l_suppkey = ps.ps_suppkey;
